# graviteeam_org_tag (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM organization tag (sharding tag)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_org_tag" "example" {
  name        = "production"
  description = "Production sharding tag"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the organization tag

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the organization tag

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the organization tag
